summary: Adds or removes CVs in NURBS, Bezier, polygonal faces, and surfaces while separating shape-preserving refinement from lossy unrefinement.

key_params.name: divsu
key_params.note: U divisions for refine or subdivide

key_params.name: divsv
key_params.note: V divisions for refine or subdivide

key_params.name: space
key_params.note: Uniform domain or arc length spacing

common_gotchas: Refinement is shape-preserving, but unrefinement can smooth or melt the original surface.
Tolerance controls only apply to unrefinement, not refinement.
Use Uniform Domain Lengths when domain ranges are animated to avoid undetermined inserted points.
U and V interval fields are parametric 0-1 domains, not world-space distances.
key_concepts: Refine SOP can increase CV counts without changing shape for supported curves and surfaces.
Unrefinement removes CVs over parametric intervals and is lossy within a tolerance.
Refinement can use a single U/V location, while unrefinement requires First and Second U/V interval boundaries.
Subdivide is equivalent to refine for polygons and Beziers, and maximum refinement for NURBS.
